hypotheses.text: If Ruben Saldo (CB) had been 3 m closer to Kai Nakamura, the chance to score would likely have fallen noticeably, suggesting a tighter central mark could have prevented the shot or made it less accurate.

If Kofi Asante-Rhys (LB) had been 5 m closer to Kai Nakamura, the reduced space on the shooter's left would have cut the shooting angle and chance to score, indicating closer wide pressure could have stopped the goal.

If Lukas Hagen (CB) had been 5 m closer to Kai Nakamura, increased central pressure would likely have lowered the chance to score, showing that more aggressive closing from the central defenders could have prevented the finish.
